guarantees.claim: When SecSkipPRNGReseeding is false, seed is assigned as the concatenation of buffer_q and entropy_i.
When SecSkipPRNGReseeding is false, seed_valid is high iff buffer_valid_q, entropy_req_o, and entropy_ack_i are all high.
entropy_req_o is held low when SecSkipPRNGReseeding is true; otherwise it asserts when reseed_req_i is high and seed_valid is low.
reseed_ack_o is driven by reseed_req_i when SecSkipPRNGReseeding is true, otherwise by seed_valid.

assumptions.claim: buffer_valid_q correctly indicates that buffer_q holds valid data for reseeding.
assumptions.cond: when SecSkipPRNGReseeding is false and reseed_req_i is asserted
assumptions.risk: Using stale or invalid buffer_q data could compromise the PRNG seed quality.

assumptions.claim: entropy_ack_i is a valid acknowledgement from the entropy source, synchronous and glitch-free.
assumptions.risk: seed_valid may glitch or assert with an incomplete handshake, causing premature or repeated seed updates.

assumptions.claim: SecSkipPRNGReseeding is a compile-time constant parameter, not toggling during operation.
assumptions.risk: If it changes dynamically, glitches may occur on entropy_req_o and reseed_ack_o.

uncertain_points.claim: There is a combinational feedback loop: seed_valid depends on entropy_req_o (buffer_valid_q & entropy_req_o & entropy_ack_i), and entropy_req_o depends on ~seed_valid (reseed_req_i & ~seed_valid). This does not include a register and may cause oscillation or undefined simulation behavior.
uncertain_points.cond: when SecSkipPRNGReseeding is false and buffer_valid_q is high
uncertain_points.risk: Seed_valid or entropy_req_o could glitch, leading to false positive seed_valid assertions or missed reseed handshakes, potentially injecting corrupted seed data into the LFSR.

uncertain_points.claim: The concatenation {buffer_q, entropy_i} may not match the expected LFSR seed width; if LFSR width is not exactly buffer_q width plus entropy_i width, truncation or zero-extension could occur.
uncertain_points.risk: The PRNG seed may be misaligned, reducing entropy quality or causing functional failure.

uncertain_points.claim: The reseed_ack_o pulse timing from seed_valid (which is combinational and may be only one cycle due to handshake) may not match the consumer's expected ack protocol.
uncertain_points.cond: when reseed_ack_o is driven by seed_valid
uncertain_points.risk: Ack could be missed or misinterpreted, causing the reseed requester to hang or retry incorrectly.
